title: Product Rule: Paid Cabin Upgrades on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand
content:
**Product rule — paid cabin upgrades.** This rule governs the purchase of a paid move into a higher cabin on a ticket of Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force** and are superseded by the current upgrade charge bases:

- the clause that a paid upgrade moves the passenger on one unflown segment into a higher cabin for a fixed fee;
- the clause that the fee is the fare brand's Premium Economy upgrade fee for a move into Premium Economy, and its short-segment or long-segment First upgrade fee for a move into First on segments up to and including the segment length threshold or longer.

## Conditions in force

- A paid upgrade is available only when the ticket's fare brand sells paid upgrades: Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus, Crestline Main Flexible and Crestline Premium Economy.
- A paid upgrade can be purchased only while the ticket is ticketed or partially flown, and only for a segment not yet flown.
- The fare brand, the ticket's refund and change rules and its accrual basis are unchanged by a paid upgrade.
- A cabin already confirmed on the segment through a complimentary Summit upgrade or an upgrade certificate is never sold again as a paid upgrade.
- A paid upgrade that is not provided is refunded under the fee-refund rule.

| Hypothetical situation | Paid upgrade |
|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy ticket, unflown segment | Not available (brand does not sell it) |
| Crestline First ticket | Not available (brand does not sell it) |
| Crestline Main Plus ticket, partially flown, next segment unflown | Available for that segment |
| Crestline Main Cabin ticket, segment already cleared into First on an upgrade certificate | Not sold again for that segment |
| Crestline Main Flexible ticket after an upgrade | Still refundable under its own refund rule |

superseded_clauses: A paid upgrade moves the passenger on one unflown segment into a higher cabin for a fixed fee.

The fee is paid_upgrade_to_premium_economy_fee for a move into Premium Economy, and paid_upgrade_to_first_fee_short_segment or paid_upgrade_to_first_fee_long_segment for a move into First on segments up to and including segment_length_threshold_miles or longer.
